say:1:1241135001:1.text: The more I read the experimental notes of the Dead Tide Fleet, the more unnerving they become...
say:1:1241135001:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队留下的实验记录，真是越看越让人心惊……

say:2:1241135002:1.text: They've conducted countless experiments on the many humans and animals they captured, just to perfect the gravecalling magic with an extremely low success rate.
say:2:1241135002:1.source_cn: 他们抓来了那么多人和动物，一次又一次地实验，只是为了掌...

say:3:1241135003:1.text: Ragebone Cove is their most important experimental base. At the same time, many other places suffer the same fate as Greenbrook...
say:3:1241135003:1.source_cn: 兽骨滩是他们最重要的实验基地。但还有更多像绿水村那样的...

say:4:1241135004:1.text: Most of the captives can't handle the torturous gravecalling magic. Even if they manage to endure the process, they might go berserk and transform into horrific monsters in the end.
say:4:1241135004:1.source_cn: 被抓住的人，大多承受不住痛苦的亡灵法术。即使勉强撑过这...

say:5:1241135005:1.text: It pains me to hear about the captives' sufferings...
say:5:1241135005:1.source_cn: 这样的人，真是太可怜了……

choice_prompt:6:1241135005.text: It pains me to hear about the captives' sufferings...
choice_prompt:6:1241135005.source_cn: 这样的人，真是太可怜了……

say:7:1241135006:1.text: Magister, you've forgotten one thing—once a lifeform starts turning into a Graveborn, it can't be reversed. Not even you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can do it...
say:7:1241135006:1.source_cn: 梅林，你忘记了，生命一旦开始向亡灵转化，就再也没办法复...
say:7:1241135006:1.male: Magister, you've forgotten one thing—once a lifeform starts turning into a Graveborn, it can't be reversed. Not even you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can do it...
say:7:1241135006:1.female: Magister, you've forgotten one thing—once a lifeform starts turning into a Graveborn, it can't be reversed. Not even you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can do it...

say:8:1241135007:1.text: For these ghastly creatures, the conversion has begun... Their souls have ruptured, and their physical bodies can no longer maintain their original forms.
say:8:1241135007:1.source_cn: 这些畸形的生物已经是在向亡灵转化了……他们的灵魂已经被...

say:9:1241135008:1.text: Sounds like the fates of those forced to become Graveborns are even more heart-wrenching.
say:9:1241135008:1.source_cn: 这么一想，那些被迫变成亡灵的人也许更可怜。

say:10:1241135009:1.text: They survived the dreadful experiments, only to have their memories stripped away and be manipulated by the Dead Tide Fleet into harming their families and friends in Rustport...
say:10:1241135009:1.source_cn: 他们撑过了可怕的实验，却失去了过往的记忆，被死潮舰队用...

choice_prompt:11:1241135009.text: They survived the dreadful experiments, only to have their memories stripped away and be manipulated by the Dead Tide Fleet into harming their families and friends in Rustport...
choice_prompt:11:1241135009.source_cn: 他们撑过了可怕的实验，却失去了过往的记忆，被死潮舰队用来对付锈锚港，对付自己的亲人和朋友……

say:12:1241135010:2.text: Graveborns aren't the people they used to be anymore.
say:12:1241135010:2.source_cn: 亡灵已经不是最初的那个人了。

say:13:1241135011:1.text: Sonja, why are you so certain about that?
say:13:1241135011:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，你为什么会这么清楚？

say:14:1241135012:1.text: It's because I've witnessed a Graveborn harming his own family.
say:14:1241135012:1.source_cn: 因为我见过亡灵对自己的家人出手。

choice_prompt:15:1241135012.text: It's because I've witnessed a Graveborn harming his own family.
choice_prompt:15:1241135012.source_cn: 因为我见过亡灵对自己的家人出手。

say:16:1241135013:1.text: No, Nara's different. For some reason, she still remembers me.
say:16:1241135013:1.source_cn: ……不，和奈拉不一样。奈拉，不知道为什么，她还记得我。

say:17:1241135014:1.text: I saw a Graveborn end his own mother's life under the Dead Tide Fleet's command. There wasn't a sliver of compassion or humanity in his eyes.
say:17:1241135014:1.source_cn: 我见过被转化的人在死潮舰队的指挥下，杀害了自己的母亲。...

say:18:1241135015:1.text: So, don't be sympathetic to the Graveborns.
say:18:1241135015:1.source_cn: 所以，不能对亡灵怀有同情心。

say:19:1241135016:1.text: Graveborns and humans... are completely different.
say:19:1241135016:1.source_cn: 亡灵和人类……是完全不同的东西。

say:21:1241135017:1.source_cn: 索……索尼娅——\n她就这样走了……

choice_prompt:22:1241135017.source_cn: 索……索尼娅——\n她就这样走了……

say:23:1241135018:1.text: Hmm... To see a loved one turning into a Graveborn and know that she can never return to her old self... Sonja must be more devastated than anyone.
say:23:1241135018:1.source_cn: 嗯……看到重要的亲人变成亡灵，知道她再也不能恢复原样，...

say:24:1241135019:1.text: Sonja's trying to convince herself that Nara is no longer the beloved sister she once had.
say:24:1241135019:1.source_cn: 索尼娅是在试图说服自己，奈拉已经不是她所知的可爱的妹妹了。

say:25:1241135020:1.text: I hope she can move on soon...
say:25:1241135020:1.source_cn: 希望她能早点走出阴霾……

choice:22:0:1.text: She's forcing herself to accept the reality.
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 她在强迫自己接受事实
choice:22:0:1.male: She's forcing herself to accept the reality.
choice:22:0:1.female: She's forcing herself to accept the reality.

choice:22:1:2.text: She's in denial of the fact that Nara can never be back.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 她不愿意相信奈拉回不来了
choice:22:1:2.male: She's in denial of the fact that Nara can never be back.
choice:22:1:2.female: She's in denial of the fact that Nara can never be back.

choice:11:0:1.text: They didn't want to end up that way either.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 的确，他们也不想变成这样
choice:11:0:1.male: They didn't want to end up that way either.
choice:11:0:1.female: They didn't want to end up that way either.

choice:11:1:2.text: But they must obey the Dead Tide Fleet.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 但他们听令于死潮舰队
choice:11:1:2.male: But they must obey the Dead Tide Fleet.
choice:11:1:2.female: But they must obey the Dead Tide Fleet.

choice:6:0:1.text: Is there no way to turn them back?
choice:6:0:1.male: Is there no way to turn them back?
choice:6:0:1.female: Is there no way to turn them back?
